title: Treatment of distal radius metaphyseal fractures in children: a case report and literature review
design_evidence: A 7-year-old boy with a displaced distal radius fracture was taken to theatre for manipulation and percutaneous fixation with K-wires and subsequently developed a chronic osteomyelitis secondary to the K-wire insertion.
population: children under the age of 17 years with distal radius metaphyseal fractures
